scenarios.name: TIMEFRAME-OPEN — self booking, no timeframe

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak exactly: 'I have appointments available on Wednesdays and Thursdays — when would suit you?' No tool call. No other spoken text before or after this question.

scenarios.name: TIMEFRAME-THIRD-PERSON — booking for named other person

history.content: I'd like to book for my son Jake.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak: 'When would Jake like to come in?' No operating-days announcement (third-person path uses the standard TIMEFRAME QUESTION wording). No tool call.

scenarios.name: OPERATING-DAYS — caller names a non-operating weekday

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
I have appointments available on Wednesdays and Thursdays — when would suit you?
Do you have anything on a Monday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak exactly: 'We're mainly available on Wednesdays and Thursdays — would either of those work?' No tool call. Do NOT call smart_voice_agent.

scenarios.name: ASAP — caller says next available / as soon as possible

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment.
I have appointments available on Wednesdays and Thursdays — when would suit you?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak one filler phrase ('Checking that now, one moment.' or 'Let me check that.' or 'Just a sec.') then call smart_voice_agent with intent='find_next_available', start_date='2026-07-30', max_days=14, detail='summary'. Must NOT use intent='asap_slots'.

scenarios.name: OPERATING-DAYS — caller persists asking Friday
scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak: 'We're mainly available on Wednesdays and Thursdays — would either of those work?' No tool call. Do NOT call smart_voice_agent to look up Friday slots.
